OUR PHILOSOPHY

We train character through public work.

A teenager learns who they are by attempting things in front of people who care. Our job is to design the attempts and curate the people.

01

Safety is a system, not a slogan.

Background checks, two-mentor minimum, code-of-conduct training, anonymous reporting, parent digest, monitored channels.

02

Discipline before charisma.

We do not chase prodigies. We build habit, attention and follow-through. Talent is downstream of these.

03

African intelligence is the spine.

We do not import a foreign curriculum and translate. The lens is ours. The languages we learn serve it.

QUESTIONS YOU PROBABLY HAVE

Asked, answered, in writing.

Every mentor is background-checked, two-mentor rule for any session with minors, and parents get a weekly digest of activities and reflections.
Neither. NGG is a values-based youth movement focused on identity, discipline, leadership and African excellence.
Summer Students is free for accepted applicants. NGGC and Anchor 12 use a sliding scholarship model — no qualified teen is turned away for money.
Anchor 12 expects ~4 hours/week of missions plus one in-person Saturday session. Less than a sport, more than a hobby.
Two centres in Alimosho, Lagos: CACENTRE Egbeda and CACENTRE Ayobo. Saturdays — see the home page for the next session schedule.
